name: 4-MPD
summary: Stimulant of the cathinone class. Higher homologue of Mephedrone, and the p-Methyl analogue of Pentedrone.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: 4-Methylpentedrone (also known as 4-MPD and 4-Methyl-α-methylamino-valerophenone), is a stimulant medication of the cathinone class, invented in 1960. A related compound, 4-methyl-α-ethylaminopentiophenone (4-MEAP), has been found to be incorrectly sold as 4-methylpentedrone.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like its relatives pentedrone and mephedrone, it is thought to raise levels of dopamine and noradrenaline in the brain.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和近親戊基卡西酮及喵喵一樣，會提高腦中多巴胺與正腎上腺素的濃度。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和近亲戊基卡西酮及喵喵一样，会提高脑中多巴胺与正肾上腺素的浓度。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia, anxiety, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、大量出汗、咬緊牙關、失眠、焦慮、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、大量出汗、咬紧牙关、失眠、焦虑、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: Although it reached the designer drug market only recently, 4-MPD was first made back in 1960. It is mephedrone with a carbon chain one step longer.
fact.zh: 雖然它最近才出現在設計師藥物市場上，4-MPD其實早在1960年就已首次合成。它就是碳鏈比喵喵長一節的版本。
fact.zhHans: 虽然它最近才出现在设计师药物市场上，4-MPD其实早在1960年就已首次合成。它就是碳链比喵喵长一节的版本。
